rules.name: cs-28-fx-group-legs-20nov-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT cd.contract_number, cd.trade_id, cd.market_action, cd.transaction_date, cd.original_lots::text AS original_lots_text, dt.premium::text AS price_text, cd.premium::text AS clone_price_text, cd.fixing_date, s.maturity_date AS value_date, s.derivative_type FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table cd JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.security_id = cd.security_id AND s.business_unit = cd.business_unit AND s.tenant_id = cd.tenant_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(d.premium) AS premium FROM opera.deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.trade_id = cd.trade_id AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.is_latest_version = 1) dt ON true WHERE cd.contract_number = ANY (string_to_array(:contracts, ',')) AND cd.business_unit = 'CFS' AND cd.tenant_id = :tenant AND cd.is_latest_version = 1 ORDER BY cd.contract_number

SELECT upper(substring_index(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, lower(cd.market_action) AS side, s.maturity_date AS value_date, cd.contract_number, cd.trade_id, cd.transaction_date, cast(cd.original_lots AS char) AS original_lots_text, cast(cd.premium AS char) AS price_text, cd.fixing_date, s.derivative_type FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs s JOIN dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs cd ON cd.security_id = s.security_id WHERE s.maturity_date IN ('2027-06-23', '2027-10-27') AND s.derivative_type LIKE 'fx_forward%' AND upper(substring_index(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('GBS', 'SOR', 'ORM') ORDER BY client, value_date, cd.contract_number

expect.reason: 4 legs in each of the 4 groups
